hook: orphan 金錢團來診所：impecunious／indigence／destitution／impoverish——櫃台問「健保還是自費」，大家掏出空錢包。
script: impecunious／indigence／destitution 窮。impoverish 使貧窮。fiscal 財政。default 違約。monetary 貨幣的。口令：空錢包寫「先記帳」，財政寫「別只看零用金」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 空錢包: impecunious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「空錢包」出場：impecunious 一上場梗就黏住——貧窮的。

members.senseAnchor: a state of extreme poverty or destitution
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 破口袋: indigence walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「破口袋」出場：indigence 一上場梗就黏住——貧苦。

members.senseAnchor: a state without friends or money or prospects
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 空屋: destitution walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「空屋」出場：destitution 一上場梗就黏住——赤貧。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 抽存款: impoverish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「抽存款」出場：impoverish 一上場梗就黏住——使貧窮。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 預算表: fiscal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「預算表」出場：fiscal 一上場梗就黏住——財政的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 銅板堆: monetary walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「銅板堆」出場：monetary 一上場梗就黏住——貨幣的。

members.senseAnchor: loss due to not showing up; act of failing to meet a financial obligation
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 紅字債: default walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「紅字債」出場：default 一上場梗就黏住——違約拖欠。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 破產章: insolvent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「破產章」出場：insolvent 一上場梗就黏住——無力償債的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 小氣鎖: parsimonious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「小氣鎖」出場：parsimonious 一上場梗就黏住——吝嗇的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 灑金幣: munificent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「灑金幣」出場：munificent 一上場梗就黏住——慷慨的。

related.synonyms: lavish, overgenerous, too-generous, unsparing, unstinted, unstinting

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 錢包: wallet walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「錢包」出場：wallet 一上場梗就黏住——錢包。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

pitfalls: fiscal 偏公共財政；monetary 偏貨幣
